subject: [hw] opus-decint: payload-vcodec-dec4k2 (vc7-dec4k2) STAGED: pipelined + 4-thread detile client, WC on; 10 sessions (proof + timing pairs)
body: gpu/build/apps-20261104/payload-vcodec-dec4k2, image q10jh (or later with the 384 MiB pool), owned list owned-vcodec-dec.json. vcodecd 189936bdd289497f (--decoder --guest-log 300 --dec-wc on), n2vcd_dprobe 020724ee2ca17dfa: decode thread + convert thread (read-back/detile/hash of picture N overlaps decode of N+1, max 2 pictures held), detile and hash split over 4 row bands, per-picture log 'queue= read= detile= hash= conv= us', per-stream 'stream N timing: P pictures in T ms = F fps ...'. Each stream twice: 1st with hashes (bit-exactness), 2nd hashes OFF (pure fps): 1080p60 H.264, 4K H.264, 4096x2176 H.264, 1080p60 HEVC, 4K HEVC. NEW HASH: fnvr (row hash, parallel); compare_dec.py handles it (fnv_frames.c); compare only the hashed sessions: --stream 0,2,4,6,8. PC (16 cores, fake hw): 4K conversion 6.6 ms with hash / 2.9 ms without (read 0.8-1.0, detile 2.0); unit test: banded detile == single pass, row hash == PC helper at 640x480..4096x2176 and odd sizes.
